PASS.label: Pass
PASS.caveat: Does NOT prove all factual claims in document are true.

DEFICIENCY_FOUND.label: Deficiency Found
DEFICIENCY_FOUND.caveat: Document fails explicit handbook criteria; fixable gap.

MISMATCH_FOUND.label: Mismatch Found
MISMATCH_FOUND.caveat: Inconsistency between two records; does not prove forgery.

POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE.label: Possible Duplicate
POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE.caveat: SHA-256 match found; requires contextual human review.

SIGNATURE_VALID.label: Signature Valid
SIGNATURE_VALID.caveat: Cryptographic check passed; does NOT certify truth of document claims.

SIGNATURE_INVALID_OR_BROKEN.label: Signature Invalid / Broken
SIGNATURE_INVALID_OR_BROKEN.caveat: Certificate or digest verification failed under trust policy.

SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.label: Source Unavailable
SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.caveat: External issuer API could not be reached; NOT a negative finding.

VERIFICATION_PENDING.label: Verification Pending
VERIFICATION_PENDING.caveat: Awaiting asynchronous source response or human review.

LOW_CONFIDENCE_EXTRACTION.label: Low-Confidence Extraction
LOW_CONFIDENCE_EXTRACTION.caveat: OCR confidence below floor; requires human confirmation.

MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED.label: Manual Review Required
MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED.caveat: Ambiguous handbook clause or unresolved discrepancy.

CHECK_NOT_RUN.label: Check Not Run
CHECK_NOT_RUN.caveat: Mandatory check did not execute; case evidence incomplete.

GEOTAG_ABSENT.label: Geotag Absent
GEOTAG_ABSENT.caveat: EXIF location absent; more evidence needed, not an automatic failure.

STRUCTURE_INDICATOR.label: Structure Indicator
STRUCTURE_INDICATOR.caveat: PDF revision or font anomaly detected; indicator, requires review.
